turn.user_message: How is the summary drafted all through the stay?
turn.context: Playbook §5, the first 'tell me more': the summary drafted all through the stay, from the reference's list of what is tracked.

text: The night showed the summary appear on the evening round. It can, because it has been writing itself since admission.
Each day, Tojo records what happens to the patient. By the evening round, most of the summary is already there.
chat.pointer: Pick a day of the stay, or press Play the stay. Watch the summary fill.
chat.note: The summary is written a little each day, not all at once.
prompts: Explain the first three steps on the round
Won’t this take our nurses’ time?
What if a report comes in late?

blocks.title: The record that writes itself
blocks.deck: Seven kinds of fact, recorded as they happen, fill the summary day by day. Nothing is typed twice at the end.

kinds.name: Tests and findings
kinds.example: Each result, with anything unusual marked

kinds.name: Procedures
kinds.example: Each procedure or surgery, with its notes

kinds.name: Medicines
kinds.example: Given, changed and left over, counted in strips

kinds.name: Supplies
kinds.example: Used and left over, in whole units

kinds.name: Daily progress
kinds.example: The doctor’s notes on each round

kinds.name: Reasons and outcomes
kinds.example: Why each step was taken, and what happened

events.text: Blood tests and a heart tracing
Tests ordered to rule out a heart attack
Heart scan shows a narrowed vessel
Scan ordered because the pain came back
A stent placed in the narrowed vessel
Stent chosen to open the vessel
Doctor says the patient can go tomorrow
Two strips of one medicine left over
Discharge planned, the patient is stable

blocks.condition: The patient here is an example only. Your records would fill the summary the same way.
